message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: defendant bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) and attempted to sell, also defrauded victim of 500 million? Actually 500万元 (5 million). He used money for personal use. So crimes: illegal trafficking of cultural relics? The purchase of prohibited cultural relics is illegal possession/trafficking of cultural relics. Also fraud (诈骗). Possibly also illegal business of cultural relics (非法买卖文物). The prosecution says "构成××和诈骗罪". So answer should be "非法买卖文物;诈骗". In examples they use terms like "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药". For cultural relics, typical charge: "非法买卖文物罪". So answer: [罪名]非法买卖文物;诈骗<eoa>
